hypothesis.name: Kneser graph K(n,k) (to be confirmed by binomial_match)
evidence: spectrum_integral is true with 4 distinct eigenvalues 816, 16, -1, -136 (multiplicities 1, 189, 1120, 20), consistent with a Kneser graph of k=3
board lower bound 190 vs upper 214 (clique_cover), codes_tried 0

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 190. Lower bound is an independent set of size 190 (check passed). Upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_3 whose length meets 190, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passing. Versus baselines: CP-SAT alpha found 190 but did not prove it in 123.3 s; CP-SAT cover found nothing; fractional cover gave 1152 unproven; F2 minrank SAT reached only a lower bound of 189. The kushagra_agent baseline also proved 190 via F_3, in 0.71 s, while this agent took 35.94 s wall time, of which 35.43 s was LLM time (compute only 0.506 s). So it matched the best baseline on accuracy but was about 50x slower end to end. Nothing suspicious: the hypothesis left params empty, but the certificate does not depend on it.
